name: catalog
sql: CREATE TABLE catalog(product_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,merchant_index INTEGER,title TEXT,price_cents INTEGER,channel3_id TEXT,source TEXT)

name: customers
sql: CREATE TABLE customers(customer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,segment TEXT,purchases INTEGER,last_purchase_day INTEGER)

name: merchants
sql: CREATE TABLE merchants(merchant_index INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT,stock INTEGER,max_offer_pct INTEGER)

name: metadata
sql: CREATE TABLE metadata(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT)

name: observations
sql: CREATE TABLE observations(action_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,day INTEGER,customer_id TEXT,selected_action TEXT,propensity REAL,matures_day INTEGER,reward_cents INTEGER,bias REAL,recency_30d REAL,purchases_7d REAL,offers_7d REAL,price_scale REAL,observed_merchant_affinity REAL,recent_refunds REAL)

name: orders
sql: CREATE TABLE orders(order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,day INTEGER,merchant_index INTEGER,customer_id TEXT,gross_cents INTEGER,observed_refund_cents INTEGER,modeled_fee_cents INTEGER,processing_cents INTEGER)
